title: ICT Breakout Pending Orders @ Candle Midpoint

entry_short: detect large upcandle (body >150p) in overbought RSI; pending sell at midpoint; similar 5-bar timeout
exit: no SL/TP at entry; trailing stop after 2+ orders filled; close_money 30 (forward mode) or 5 (reverse mode)

title: Multigroup Scalping TMA (3-EMA) Dip Entry
entry_long: EMA_fast > EMA_slow > EMA_trend (uptrend aligned); price pullback (close_ID10 > close_ID1); buy 0.01 fixed
entry_short: EMA_fast < EMA_slow < EMA_trend (downtrend aligned); price bounce (close_ID10 < close_ID1); sell 0.01
exit: close_money formula: 5 USD base + (open_order_count / C_order_B) * 5 (dynamic target scaling); grid escalation +0.01 per 5 orders
buildon_idea: dynamic close_money is smart; add SL at candle extreme; test linear-add instead of grid; validate EMA periods (8/18/100 tunable)
novelty_note: uses 3-EMA alignment + price pullback (2-candle close comparison); high-frequency scalper; 2025 Q1-2: 5746 orders, 34.5% return 10k, 19.82% DD; works across both buy+sell modes; requires cut-loss mode enabled to survive volatile periods
